up: For document CHEMBL1697731, list all molecules reported in that document. For each molecule, return the ChEMBL ID, molecule name (pref_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical SMILES. Order the results by the ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH doc_mols AS (SELECT DISTINCT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1697731' AND cr.molregno IS NOT NULL) SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM doc_mols dm JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dm.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON dm.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY md.chembl_id
